meaning: Selected hosted Responses, MCP and output-reference declarations, with executable hosted request fields; MCP uses provider-owned approval continuation and private replay. Credentials resolve separately at request time and require a stable binding identity; credential fields are excluded from executable configuration snapshots. Provider approval response echoes must match a trusted decision and do not create a new approval. This does not establish complete MCP protocol, model or live parity; not a claim of complete nested semantics, live behavior or endpoint parity. Four annotation forms have typed public reference projections. Native positions remain opaque, distinct from enclosing UTF-16 text segments. Scoped file handles are deliberately public references; unknown fields and native replay stay private. Completed image bytes become public ImagePart content. Partial images, precise native-coordinate highlights, hosted progress and downloaded container files remain open. External type references are retained, not expanded. Other tools, local executors and unselected declarations are excluded.
